sweep_bank.applies_to: the echo (noise and reverberation terms alike): a bank of time-scaled sweep replicas recovers the sweep's Doppler mismatch loss
sweep_bank.source: docs/tasks/doppler_baseline.json via docs/tasks/DOPPLER.md Sec. 3.2: popoto_12km ship at 12 km, range rate -0.50 m/s, 4-6 kHz 1 s sweep: 24.0 -> 25.9 dB (+1.9)
sweep_bank.limits: measured at one radial speed (-0.50 m/s) on this band; larger at higher speed (flank_32 6-10 kHz: +5.9 dB at 2 m/s), not measured here at the classes' speeds; nothing for a target with no radial speed

tone.applies_to: a moving target outside the reverberation's Doppler ridge: the reverberation term is removed (the bank's margin reaches its noise ceiling); taken here as the noise-only margin less 4.1 dB (a Hann tone of the sweep's energy needs 4.1 dB more peak power: with a peak-limited projector it carries 4.1 dB less energy)
tone.source: docs/tasks/DOPPLER.md Sec. 3.2-3.3 (flank_patrol small vehicle: 7.0 -> 39.8 dB, at its ceiling; +33 to +37 dB); 4.1 dB: Sec. 0 item 4
tone.status: ours (simulated); the tone must lie outside the sweep's band in the same ping, or on its own pings (waveform package d2-train, ours: inside the band it gains nothing over a reverberating bottom)
tone.limits: the 0.8 m/s radial speed is ours: the baseline's full recovery at +0.5 m/s with a 1 s tone at 8 kHz, scaled by the speed resolution c/(2 f T) to 5 kHz; nothing for a stationary or crossing target (a 12 km crossing ship's radial speed is about 0.4 m/s: DOPPLER.md Sec. 5 q. 2); a single tone fades in multipath (18.9 dB less echo energy than the sweep on one image-source path set, DOPPLER.md Sec. 0 item 3): not in the figure; range resolution becomes c T / 2 = 750 m

baffle.applies_to: the reverberation only: a baffled face would remove about 3 dB of reverberation from behind (the model has no element pattern; omnidirectional elements hear the back half)
baffle.source: docs/PHYSICS_NOTES.md Sec. 32, 'Not in it': "a baffled face would take about 3 dB of reverberation from behind it out"
baffle.status: ours, unconfirmed (no baffle is designed or measured)

2k.projector: shipped band: T335 or TR-1075A/D by their sheets (projector_selection.md Sec. 4, option A)
2k.status: via secondary (the sheets as read in projector_selection.md)

1k.projector: any 4-6 kHz candidate; a 1 kHz band needs a mechanical Q of 5 or less (projector_selection.md Sec. 1.2)

4k.projector: T335 (sheet: 3-8 kHz) or TR-1075 (2.5-10 kHz) by their stated ranges; no level at 3 or 7 kHz is on record (projector_selection.md Sec. 3.1, 5): unconfirmed. The row's pitch (0.15 m, half a wavelength at 5 kHz) is 0.7 wavelength at 7 kHz: grating lobes inside the searched sector

hardware.board_inputs_status: confirmed: the owner's plan (PMM6081 ICD) as quoted in configs/builds/popoto_face_3x32.yaml and docs/design/popoto_parts.md
hardware.rate_status: unconfirmed: 102.4 kHz x 24 bits are assumptions (configs/builds/popoto_face_3x32.yaml: boards.sample_rate_hz, adc_bits; popoto_parts.md 'Capture boards')
hardware.batching_quote: the owner's plan, p. 14, as quoted in tools/parts_list.py: "When to stop: past two boards, the custom 32-channel ADC board in Phase 6 is cheaper and removes the problem with one shared clock."
hardware.price_quote: the owner's plan, p. 13, as quoted in docs/design/popoto_parts.md: "$7,825 development kit; $6,150 OEM board"

rows_measurement.what: Simulate the three-row face (popoto_long_range_3row) over the shelf: one target-only ping (one point, no reverberation, no noise) and `pings` reverberation-only pings (no scene, no noise; each a new draw). Per row, one beam on the target's bearing, pulse-compressed. From the target's per-row complex peak `a` and the reverberation's covariance R between rows within +-0.05 s of the target's delay:
rows_measurement.reverberation_generator: bistatic, 90 bins of arrival elevation (2 degrees each)

crosscheck.sonar: popoto_long_range with array.count 64 (an override in memory)

prediction.method: image series of an isovelocity layer over a fluid bottom (Rayleigh reflection), to 30 degrees of grazing

ship_12km.what_is_compared: the chain's median snr_db on the detected pings (peak over the local background) against the study's one-row SNR with the reverberation term, less the detector's window and mean straddle losses (buildspec.detection: what the threshold holds)

prediction.method: image series of an isovelocity layer over a fluid bottom (Rayleigh reflection), to 30 degrees of grazing

multi_ping.textbook: textbook rule for N looks added incoherently in the many-look limit: the threshold falls about 5 log10 N (Urick, Principles of Underwater Sound, the detection-threshold chapter; status: unconfirmed, not opened in this session)
